To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the bearing capacity of CFDST column can be effectively improved through changing the steel ratio and using UHPFRC as the infill concrete; however, for the CFST columns, only the steel ratio can be effectively used to improve the residual performance.
the bearing capacities of CFDST and CFST columns after impact loading are closely related to the steel ratio, concrete type, section form, axial compression ratio and impact energy.
the residual axial bearing capacities of CFDST and CFST columns are significantly improved when the steel ratio increases and the concrete type changes from NSC to CFDST.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the residual axial bearing capacity and the failure mode of CFDST and CFST columns after lateral impact loading, and provides a theoretical basis for the application and design of CFDST members in the future.
the residual performance of UHPFBC filled steel tubes after impact loading and can provide guidance for the design and construction of steel tube columns in the event of an earthquake or collision.
the residual axial bearing capacity performance of CFDCT columns after impact loading and the influence of different factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, for both non impacted specimens and impacted specimens, CFDST columns have a better residual performance than CFST columns.
the UHPFRC-filled steel tube column exhibits better performance under the impact loading condition.
the residual axial bearing capacity is mainly determined by the steel ratio and the concrete type, and is also affected by the section form and the presence/ absence of impact load.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

CFDST columns exhibit a better residual performance than CFST columns under impact loading, and that the CFDST column with the inner steel tube and the outer UHPFRC is the most suitable for resisting impact loads.
the UHPFRC can be used as the filling material for CFST columns, which will provide a new direction for the application of UHPF RC in the field of civil engineering.

the residual bearing capacity of CFDST column is more than 1.5 times higher than that of the CFST column, and that the residual bearing capacities are significantly improved by increasing the steel ratio and changing the concrete type from NSC to CFDST.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the same steel ratio, the CFDST column has higher residual performance than the CFST column, and the residual performance can be further enhanced by using UHPFRC as the concrete type.
the UHPFRC-filled CFDST columns exhibit superior residual bearing capacity compared to the NSC-filled CFDST and CFST columns.

the CFDST and CFST columns exhibit excellent residual performance after impact loading, and that the CFDSTD and CFST columns can achieve satisfactory performance under various loading conditions, especially when the concrete type is UHPFRC.
